style: Premium photoreal photograph for a fitness app, calm and minimal, true-to-life materials, soft natural light, gentle shadows, crisp focus. No people, no hands. No text, letters, numbers, logos, brand marks, labels, stickers, screens with content, watermarks or signage anywhere.

images.alt: A quiet home training corner with a mat and dumbbells
images.prompt: A quiet corner of a modern living room at golden hour set up for a home workout: a charcoal exercise mat unrolled on light oak floorboards, a pair of black hexagonal dumbbells and a terracotta (#C44933) resistance band on the mat, a sturdy wooden chair to one side, a large plant and a window with sheer curtains letting in warm low sun. Wide shot, plenty of calm empty space on the left third of the frame, shallow depth of field.

images.alt: An empty gym floor with racks and dumbbells
images.prompt: An empty, clean, modern gym floor in moody low light: a row of black power racks with barbells, a long dumbbell rack, rubber flooring, a single warm terracotta (#C44933) light strip glowing along the far wall, soft haze catching the light. Wide shot, plenty of calm empty space on the left third of the frame, shallow depth of field.
